text:
gita: Heads up from today's design review 1: the Console's small help inlay labels the feature 'Policy' but the reference docs title and anchors use 'Rule set'. Users click Help and see two different words back-to-back.

ryan: That's subtle but annoying. Which term is the canonical one in the product spec?

lena: Product note: the internal spec used 'policy' early on, but when docs went live we used 'rule set' to be more explicit. No one aligned the in-product copy.

docs-bot: search-metrics: "policy" queries = 41%, "rule set" = 34%, "rules" = 25% over the last 6 months. Mixed signals.

gita: UX problem: the inlay width is tight on mobile; adding parentheses like "Policy (Rule set)" creates awkward wrapping. Also SR reads the header verbatim.

ryan: Options: 1) swap Console to 'Rule set' 2) keep 'Policy' but add a tiny micro-link 'About terms' that anchors into docs 3) create a canonical /docs/policy endpoint that explains aliasing.

lena: My vote is 2 + 3: keep the short Console label 'Policy' (less jargony), add a small 'About terms' icon next to the title that opens the docs anchor, and create a canonical /docs/policy page that states: "Policy (aka Rule set in docs/examples)."

a11y: Accessibility flag: make sure ARIA labels match the chosen wording. If Console says 'Policy' but the doc H1 is 'Rule set', screen readers will sound inconsistent. ARIA on the micro-link should announce the alias, e.g., "About terms: Policy equals rule set in docs".

docs-bot: recommendation: add a glossary entry for 'policy / rule set' and map the common search terms so users land on the canonical page.

gita: Layout note: micro-link should be an icon + tooltip so header remains one line. On narrow widths open the glossary modal instead of navigating to a new tab to keep context.

eng-ops: I can add a search synonym mapping ("rule set" and "rules" -> "policy"), a lightweight redirect from /docs/ruleset -> /docs/policy, and a short analytics event when the micro-link is clicked. Will feature-flag rollout.

ryan: Docs action: lena, can you add the policy anchor and the alias sentence up top? Also annotate code snippets where examples still show 'rule_set:' fields.

lena: Yep. I'll add a line at the top: "In the Console this is labeled 'Policy'. In examples and manifests it's often called 'rule set' or 'rules'." I'll include redirects and a short changelog entry. Target: Thu EOD.

a11y: I'll run a screen-reader smoke test on the micro-link and header text after design ships. Ensure keyboard focus order is obvious and the aria description is readable.

gita: Design: I'll mock the little info icon + tooltip and the modal flow for mobile. Will post Figma frames later today.

eng-ops: Timeline: I'll queue the search synonym and redirect after docs PR merges, deploy behind flag next sprint, and keep analytics on for two weeks to check reduction in cross-link drops.

ryan: TL;DR: keep Console label 'Policy' for brevity, add 'About terms' micro-link to a canonical /docs/policy page that explains 'rule set' alias, add redirects and search synonyms, fix ARIA. Owners: design=gita, docs=lena, eng=eng-ops, a11y=a11y. :+1:

lena: Thanks 1: will post the docs PR and changelog link here when ready."
